name: Girigiri Love
source:
Main character's father remarries and brings new family to live together. But soon protagonist's childhood friend Kana dies, and he flees from this town to study abroad. A few years later he returns to his home town, familiar yet so different already.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-december-2002-popotan.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公的父亲再婚，新家庭搬来同住。然而不久后，主人公的青梅竹马香奈去世，他逃离这座城镇，前往国外求学。数年后，他回到故乡；一切既熟悉，却又早已不同。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-december-2002-popotan.html]vndbreview[/url]]
